snippet.title: OCTOPATH TRAVELER & OCTOPATH TRAVELER II | Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore Orsterra in OCTOPATH TRAVELER and Solistia in OCTOPATH TRAVELER II on Nintendo Switch™ 2, with improved resolution and framerate, on October 1, 2026.

The OCTOPATH TRAVELER series is an RPG series which features HD-2D graphics, a fusion of retro pixel art and 3DCG.

Where will you go? What will you do? Whose tale will you bring to life?
Every path is yours to take.
Embark on an adventure all your own.

Both titles are now available for pre-order digitally and physically as individual games and digitally only as a bundle.

© SQUARE ENIX
